appearance_facts.fact: The mark for Service Quality is the highest on the page, positioned near the 60 grid line.
The mark for Service Cost is positioned lower than the top row, aligned with the 45 grid line.
The mark for Service Design is positioned near the top, aligned with the 60 grid line.
The mark for Support Access is positioned near the top, aligned with the 60 grid line.
The mark for Service Delivery is positioned in the lower half of the chart, aligned with the 30 grid line.
The mark for Other is the lowest on the page, positioned between the 20 and 25 grid lines.
All six marks are identical blue circles of the same size, distinguished only by their vertical position and horizontal placement.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category'.
Vertical axis is labeled 'Value' with a scale from 0 to 65 in increments of 5.
Percentage labels above the marks are: 50% (Service Quality), 42% (Service Cost), 47% (Service Design), 51% (Support Access), 18% (Service Delivery), and 38% (Other).

public_definitions: Routing criterion: Lowest feedback share in the dashboard
uncertain: The visual vertical position of the 'Other' mark (approx 23-24) is lower than the 'Service Delivery' mark (approx 31), which contradicts the printed percentage labels (38% vs 18%).
It is unclear whether to prioritize the visual vertical position (lower on page) or the printed numeric labels (lowest percentage) when determining the 'lowest' share.
